summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Fast Track Group, a Singapore-based foreign private issuer, reporting strategic co-brand partnership agreements with Sony Music Entertainment Malaysia. The agreements cover a Global Digital Content Platform and an Offline Regional Launchpad Initiative for live showcases and touring in Southeast Asia. FTE retains 100% of IP and 90% of net profits. There are no acquisition terms, price, premium, or change in control. This is a standard business development disclosure, not a special situation.
